findingDetails.title: Section 18.5 still names numbered category slots that the playbook no longer has
findingDetails.case: An operator reads section 18.5 to find where the daemon scenarios live, follows "in 05" to a category folder or section numbered 05, and finds neither: the daemon section is AUTO UPDATE DAEMON and the folder is auto-update-daemon/.
findingDetails.scopeProof: ls of the playbook root prints nine bare kebab-case folders and no NN--* entry; rg -n "in `0[1-9]`" over the playbook root returns only lines 341, 345 and 346.

findingDetails.title: The tests README package-topology block omits the doctor/ suite folder
findingDetails.case: A maintainer scanning the package-topology block for doctor coverage before changing a doctor bridge sees no doctor/ row and concludes the folder does not exist, while section 4 and the disk both hold it.
findingDetails.scopeProof: find of the tests folder prints fourteen directories including doctor; section 3 lists thirteen; the same omission is present at 2a1a42263cc, so it predates the fix.
